tools.name: check_url
tools.description: Check a public web page or file URL for AI: fetches it and reads AI labels, AI-use statements, Content Credentials and saved creation records found there, with an AI-likelihood score for the image. Use for: is this article, news photo, product image or social post AI-generated or fake? Logins, paywa

tools.name: extract_saved_prompt
tools.description: Read the prompt, negative prompt, model and settings saved inside an image by AUTOMATIC1111, ComfyUI (including Flux workflows), InvokeAI or NovelAI. Only reads records stored in the file; it never reconstructs or guesses a prompt. Screenshots and re-uploads usually remove these records. Docs: https

Reports the manifest, recorded actions and digital source type, with cryptographic validation and signer trust as separate findings. Docs: https://isgenai.com/developers/mcp

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_text, check_url, check_image, read_content_credentials · Private data: check_text, check_url, check_image, extract_saved_prompt, read_content_credentials · Public sink: check_text, check_url, estimate_x_ai_replies · Destructive: extract_saved_prompt.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_text, check_url, check_image, read_content_credentials · Private data: check_text, check_url, check_image, extract_saved_prompt, read_content_credentials · Public sink: check_text, check_url, estimate_x_ai_replies · Destructive: extract_saved_prompt

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "check_text" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
